title: Multimedia Officer
description: The candidate will be responsible for producing high-quality photography, videography, and multimedia content, designing and maintaining the company website, and supporting internal and external communications with engaging visual content that reflects the company’s brand. Key Responsibilities Plan, shoot, and edit professional photography for corporate events, projects, and people. Plan, film, and edit video content including corporate videos, event coverage, interviews, promotional clips, and social media reels. Create motion graphics, animations, titles, and visual effects using Adobe After Effects. Edit and produce final video outputs using Adobe Premiere Pro, including colour correction, audio mixing, subtitles, and transitions. Retouch, edit, and manipulate images using Adobe Photoshop for digital and print use. Design, develop, update, and maintain the company website using WordPress. Make sure website content is accurate, current, visually consistent, and optimised for performance, mobile devices, and SEO. Manage WordPress themes, plugins, page layouts, media libraries, and routine updates. Create multimedia content for social media platforms, digital campaigns, presentations, and internal communications. Design visual assets such as banners, infographics, social media posts, brochures, and digital advertisements. Make sure all multimedia content follows company brand guidelines and quality standards. Coordinate with Marketing, Business Development, HR, and other departments to understand content needs and deliver on time. Manage multiple multimedia projects at once, meeting deadlines and priorities. Maintain an organised archive of photos, videos, graphics, and raw footage for future use. Set up, operate, and maintain photography, videography, lighting, and audio equipment. Cover corporate events, site visits, site progress, launches, and ceremonies as required. Monitor content performance and recommend improvements based on engagement and analytics. Keep up to date with multimedia trends, design techniques, social media formats, and emerging tools. Required Experience Bachelor’s degree in Multimedia, Graphic Design, Digital Media, Visual Communication, Film Production, or a related field. 3–5 years of experience in multimedia production, photography, videography, or digital content creation. Strong skills in professional photography and videography, including composition, lighting, and camera operation. Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe After Effects. Hands-on experience designing, building, and managing websites on WordPress. Strong portfolio showing photography, video production, motion graphics, and web design work. Good knowledge of social media platforms and content formats. Understanding of brand identity, visual storytelling, and design principles. Ability to handle a project from concept and shooting through editing and final delivery. Strong creative, organisational, and time management skills. Good communication skills and the ability to work with multiple stakeholders. UAE/GCC experience is an advantage. Preferred Experience Corporate and event photography Corporate and promotional video production Motion graphics and animation Website design and WordPress development Social media content creation Graphic design for digital and print media Drone photography and videography Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS and SEO Familiarity with other Adobe Creative Cloud tools (Illustrator, InDesign, Lightroom)
